description: Covers applying FAIR principles to machine learning artifacts: making models findable and reusable with model cards and rich repository metadata, documenting datasets with Croissant and datasheet-style records, licensing models and weights, linking the model-data-code-paper cluster with persistent identifiers, and the RDA FAIR4ML metadata direction. Use when a project trains, fine-tunes, publishes or reuses ML models or ML-ready datasets, when the user mentions model cards, Croissant, datasheets, FAIR4ML or model licensing, when a model heads to a hub or archive, or when evaluating whether a third-party model is documented well enough to build on. (General software FAIR is rseng-fair-software; automated repository scoring is rseng-fairguard.)
